name: semantic-router-benchmark-data
description: A dataset for evaluating semantic routing: mapping user queries to the correct handler or knowledge source. It contains labeled query-to-destination examples intended to measure routing/classification performance across domains and intents. Useful for benchmarking intent classifiers and semantic router systems in retrieval-augmented and multi-skill pipelines.
reputation: A niche community dataset on Hugging Face used by researchers experimenting with semantic routing, with modest adoption.
